coder_notes: Solid-tumour first-in-human trial; glioblastoma IDH-wildtype is explicitly eligible (dose escalation B) in the inclusion criteria and keywords, soft tissue sarcoma in escalation A. GD2 appears only in the drug name and keywords (GD2 prevalence), not as an entry requirement in the registered text; MGMT is mentioned only as a determinant of prior therapy, not an eligibility biomarker.
